controls.name: archive requires exact bytes/Gitblob/file inventory and refuses mutation
source server returns exact raw bytes and records actual hashes
changed source request is a retained failure, never accepted as original source
unmanifested source is rejected and original missing-source failures remain explicit
all three native runner servers use the same source guard with original callbacks
final queue remains ordered, opt-in, exact-SHA, fail-closed and retains original GC counts
